Cape Arundel Golf Club: Maine’s Golden Age Marvel | Course Closeup

By LINKS Magazine

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

Designed by Walter Travis in 1896, Cape Arundel Golf Club is a historic and architectural marvel tucked into just 88 acres near Kennebunkport, Maine. What the Golden Age design might lack in length—a par-69 tipping out at less than 6,000 yards—it makes up for in imagination. Learn more in this “Course Closeup.”

Produced and filmed by Erik Matuszewski.
